page.layout: One page: a list of names, each group headed by a year, in one column with a narrow column of notes to its right. The years stand in the left margin, beside the names. Reading order: the names column from top to bottom, then the right-hand notes, which are part of the page's own text blocks.

main_text.l: Hillebrant Rolteman.Præfectura vetus à milite Com. Eñonis [?] fœdè afflicta. Arx Grethana Geldris dedita & pax instaurata.
Eltet to Lellens.GRONINGA iniuriis Geld. iritata in fidem domus Burgund. concedit cum agro vicino. DAMMONA à G. Scenkio capta.
Hillebrant Rolteman.Proceres Geldriae aduersus principem suū insurgentes, eam conditionib. circumscribunt.
Reint Alberda.Esena à Bremenfibus capta, & Balthasar ac Com. Enno mortui.

page.notes: The right-hand notes are printed in small type beside the names; each is placed beside the line it aligns with. The reading "Com. Eñonis" is uncertain (the ñ-like sign may be an abbreviation); marked [?]. Rules between the year groups are not transcribed. Spelling is as printed (Iohan, Iarges, Iohan Schatter, etc.).
